attackers_goals: Remotely enable RDP on the host for lateral movement.
description: An attacker may remotely enable RDP connections to a machine by setting the fDenyTSConnections Registry key to 0.
investigative_actions: Check whether the executing process is benign and if this was a desired behavior as part of its normal execution flow. Search for RDP sessions to this host and investigate them for malicious activities.
name: RDP connections enabled remotely via Registry
required_data: XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)
